recipe.visualDefinition: A high-fashion surrealist composition featuring a central figure in a doll-like pose with exaggeratedly long limbs, set against a two-tone background of dusty rose and stark white, accented by voluminous tulle textures and horizontal metallic stripes.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the soft, organic tulle and the rigid, geometric horizontal stripes.
Symmetry of the figure's pose against the asymmetrical flow of the fabric.
Juxtaposition of the saturated pink hair against the muted pastel environment.
coreInvariants: Exaggerated limb length creating a surreal, non-human silhouette.
Horizontal banded texture in the upper third of the frame.
Sharp horizontal horizon line dividing the pink wall and white floor.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centralized figure, occupying the middle and lower thirds, with limbs extending to the edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The figure's torso and face, framed by a large tulle fan.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, follow the horizontal line of the legs outward, then rise to the striped pattern at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper pink section and lower white section to allow for typographic breathing room.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key lighting with low-saturation backgrounds to make the high-saturation accents pop.

letterConstructionRules: Sans-serif characters are wide-set with thin, uniform stroke weights.
Script elements feature a hand-drawn, marker-like quality with varying thickness.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'P' has an elongated, sweeping descender.
Sans-serif letters have increased tracking for a luxury feel.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, spaced-out sans-serif and a fluid, expressive script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, wide-set geometric look for the secondary text.
Captures the informal, hand-written energy of the primary display word.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surreal fashion photo of a woman with bright pink hair in a seated split pose with unnaturally long legs. She wears a silver beaded corset and is surrounded by voluminous, fan-like layers of pale pink tulle. The background is a horizontal split: the top 2/3 is a dusty pink wall with thin metallic horizontal stripes at the very top, and the bottom 1/3 is a flat white floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, hand-written style script word in muted rose in the center of the white floor area. Flank this word with wide-spaced, all-caps light sans-serif text in grey, ensuring the tracking is very loose.

verificationChecks: Is the horizon line perfectly horizontal?
Is the hair the most saturated element in the frame?
Is the typography centered and balanced on the white floor?

adjustableVariables: Number of horizontal stripes at the top
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the model
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth gradients in the pink background.
Ensure the white floor is pure and lacks distracting shadows.
Verify the script text looks hand-drawn rather than a standard font.
Confirm the horizontal stripes are perfectly parallel.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surreal Fashion Layout = (Elongated Subject + Tulle Textures) / (Horizontal Color Block + Wide-Tracked Typography)
